title: 영업방 원문 차수별 처리 이력 대조

criteria.scope: One explicit original-message week in the selected year uses that week for read-only evidence. Missing, mixed or different-year markers retain selected scope and remain subject to existing server rejection. Same-scope messages compete together for history events.
criteria.response: Each scope response must match year/week/date and exact unique source identities before combining display results. A failed group cannot display completion.
criteria.completion: Green box requires full MATCHED quantity evidence or a committed, non-undone source-linked operation with entry count equal to visible changes. Manual marks and numeric candidates alone never imply completion.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 explicit original scope is never reinterpreted as a 2026 request.

dnspyEvidence.note: Client-only routing reuses existing read-only native quantity history API; no SQL or ERP writes modified.
